resources.string: Choose a device you recognize. Names can be changed by their owners. Binding uses this app while it is open.
Binding failed or expired. Try again to request a new confirmation.
Unbound locally. The other device may be offline.
Binding allows both devices to automatically receive files from each other. Only bind a device you recognize.

Binding records stay in private storage on this device: both device-key fingerprints, the binding ID, name, device type, and binding time. They are not uploaded or included in Android backups. A completed binding allows automatic reception while the app is open. Unbound devices still need approval for each file. You can unbind in Settings.
